claims.text: Images use one downscaled global crop plus up to K overlapping tiling crops (K=8 training, K=24 inference; untilable images downscaled); SFT uses 24 crops for 30% of pointing-annotated images. Video frames are single crops sampled at S=2 fps up to F=128 frames (F=384 long-context training), with uniform F-frame sampling beyond F/S seconds and the last frame always included; video pointing trains on examples with up to 60 annotated points.

The connector fuses third-to-last and ninth-from-last ViT layers: 2x2 patch windows for images (3x3 for video frames to cut tokens) pooled by multi-head attention using window means as queries, with shared image/video parameters and a shared MLP projection. The LLM receives visual tokens interleaved with text timestamps (video) or image indices (multi-image), column tokens for multi-crop aspect ratio (omitted for square single-crop), image/frame start tokens, and subtitles as timestamped text; vision tokens forward-attend across frames/images.

Three stages: lightweight image-only pre-training, joint video/image SFT (30k steps, batch 128, max length 16,384), then short long-context SFT on the same mixture (2k steps, length 36,864, F=384) with 8-GPU context-parallel groups (Ulysses attention) distributing ViT/pooling work. Packing jointly packs ViT crops and LLM tokens with message-tree encoding and masking (blocking cross-example and cross-QA attention); bidirectional attention over vision tokens and a token-weighting strategy add report-stated gains.
claims.context: arXiv:2601.10611v4 §3.2 Training (three-stage; 30k/bs128/16384; 2k/36864/F=384/CPx8/Ulysses) + Fig.3 packing/mask + Abstract recipe sentence.
